reflection.title: Reflection

Sever the Perceived Knowledge globe pillar with Religion and Finance. When the G.A.A. kills the holographic dome, unawakened minds meet catastrophic collapse — unlearn Heliocentrism now so Gateway-10 placement and EMF memory return land on stable ground.
